business_problem: Worldline needed a better way to support merchant analytics, churn prediction, and fraud-aware payment intelligence because multiple acquisitions left the payment business with disconnected systems that could not unify transactions, customers, and merchants at real-time scale.
solution_summary: Worldline uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support merchant analytics, churn prediction, and fraud-aware payment intelligence. The implementation replaced a legacy state where multiple acquisitions left the payment business with disconnected systems that could not unify transactions, customers, and merchants at real-time scale. Merchant and customer data and payment transactions move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver merchant performance insights and internal BI dashboards.
business_outcome: Worldline improved merchant analytics, churn prediction, and fraud-aware payment intelligence with measurable results including €200,000 enabling real-time insights for smarter merchant decisions, 93% reduction in monthly infrastructure costs, and 40% increase in scheme reporting, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
